app.name: paratrack

auth.personalWorkspace: A personal workspace is created automatically, invite teammates later from Settings → Team.
auth.resetBlurb: We'll email you a single-use link that expires in 30 minutes.
auth.resetOnce: This link works once. After you save, other devices will be signed out.
err.badEmail: That doesn't look like a valid email address.
err.validation: Password must be 8-72 characters. Name is required.
err.resetInvalid: That reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
err.internal: Something went wrong on our end. Please try again.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.csrf: Invalid or missing CSRF token. Reload the page and try again.

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.noActiveHint: Start a timer above and it shows up here. You can run several at once.
dash.noRecent: No sessions in the last 7 days. Start an activity above, or add a past session.
dash.focusTitle: Pause every other timer, this one keeps running
stats.title: Stats
stats.noSessionsHint: A session shows up here once its timer is stopped. Running timers live on the dashboard.
stats.durationTitle: Tracked total for the session. The Time column above is clipped to the selected period.
graph.title: When you work
graph.subtitle: Activity distribution by hour of day
graph.blurb: Columns: hours per bucket across the period, stacked by activity.
graph.noDataHint: Start tracking some activities and they'll appear here.
goals.title: Goals
goals.blurb: How much time you want to give an activity per day, week or month. Progress updates live, a running timer included.
goals.noGoalsHint: Fill in the form above to set your first target.
tags.title: Tags
tags.blurb: Tags label sessions across activities and projects: #deep-work, #morning, #meetings. Add them on a session row in Stats, then filter Stats by tag.
tags.name: Name
tags.confirmDelete: Delete this tag? It will be detached from its sessions.
tags.noTagsHint: Create a tag above, then add it to a session in Stats.
tags.filterHint: The number next to a tag is how many sessions carry it. Tap a tag on a session row and stats shows only those sessions.
projects.title: Projects
projects.blurb: A project groups the activities of one client or area. It has a color, a time budget and an hourly rate for invoices.
projects.slugHint: Leave the URL name blank and it is built from the name. Set the rate and billable flag on the project page after creating it.
projects.name: Name
projects.noSessions: No sessions in this project yet.
projects.confirmDelete: Delete project? Activities in it become Uncategorized.
projects.noActivities: No activities in this project yet.
team.switchHint: Switch workspace from the team name menu at the top left; on a phone, More → Workspaces.
team.name: name
team.createBlurb: Useful when you want a separate workspace for a side project, a client or a team.
team.dangerBlurb: Deleting this workspace removes its activities, sessions, tags and goals for everyone. You must be the owner.
team.confirmDelete: Delete this workspace? This cannot be undone.
team.confirmRemove: Remove this member from the team?
team.inviteBlurb: Anyone with the link can join the team. Links expire after 7 days and can be revoked.
profile.title: Profile
invite.blurb: A teammate invited you to share their paratrack workspace.
invite.expired: This invite has expired. Ask your teammate for a new one.
invite.used: This invite has already been used.
invite.signInAccept: Sign in to accept this invite.
invite.invalid: The link is invalid or has been revoked.
flash.forbidden: You don't have access to that team.
flash.badTeam: That team doesn't exist (or you're not in it).
flash.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox (and the server log if mail is not configured).
kbd.title: keyboard
tags.blurbFull: Tags label sessions across activities and projects: #deep-work, #morning, #meetings. Add them on a session row in Stats, then filter Stats by tag.
goals.blurbFull: How much time you want to give an activity per day, week or month. Progress updates live, a running timer included.
graph.blurbFull: Bar height is the minutes tracked in that hour across the period; color is the activity. Tap an activity below to hide or show it.
ts.title: Timesheet
ts.blurb: Your week as a table: rows are activities, columns are days. Forgot a timer? Type minutes into a cell and that becomes the day's total.
ts.hint: Cells are tracked minutes for the activity on that day. 0 clears the day. Changing a cell replaces that day's closed sessions.
reports.title: Saved reports
projects.estimateHint: Time you budget for the project. 480 = 8 h. The page shows how much is already spent.
tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.blurb: Long-lived tokens for the browser extension and the API. Treat them like passwords.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.once: Copy this token now, it is shown only once.
int.title: Integrations
int.blurb: Connect GitHub or Trello and start timers straight from imported issues and cards.
int.name: Connection name
int.secretHint: GitHub/GitLab: PAT. Trello: key:token. Jira: email:api-token. Notion: integration secret. Asana: PAT. ClickUp: API token. Todoist: API token.
int.targetHint: GitHub: owner/repo. GitLab: group/project. Jira: project key or JQL. Trello: board id. Asana: project GID. ClickUp: list id. Todoist: project id (optional). Notion: database id.
inv.title: Invoices
inv.blurb: Generate a client invoice from tracked, billable time.
inv.footNote: Generated by paratrack from tracked time. Hourly rate as set on each project.
inv.rateHint: Only billable projects with a rate are summed. Set a rate on a project's page first.
wh.title: Webhooks
wh.blurb: When something happens in the workspace, paratrack POSTs JSON to your URL. Connect tracking to chat, a CRM or your own script.
wh.empty: No webhooks yet. Add a URL above to receive events.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.blurb: Last 100 security and ops events for this workspace.
stripe.title: Online payments
stripe.blurb: Stripe Checkout lets clients pay the invoice online. Without it you can still mark invoices paid by hand.
stripe.hint: For server admins: the key can also come from PARATRACK_STRIPE_KEY. Point a Stripe webhook at /api/stripe/webhook (event checkout.session.completed).
pay.title: Payroll
pay.blurb: What to pay members for a period: each person's tracked time times their hourly pay.
pay.rateHint: Only members with an hourly pay rate are included.
pay.footNote: Generated by paratrack from tracked time. Hourly pay as set for each member.
sch.title: Schedule
sch.blurb: The plan for the week: how many minutes each member should spend per day. 0 clears a day; the % under a name is their load.
sch.hint: Default capacity is 8 h a day (change it in Settings → Members). The % under a name is planned time against weekly capacity.
mkt.title: Integration marketplace
mkt.blurb: Connect the tools your team already uses. Import tasks and start timers on them.
rep.title: Reports
rep.blurb: Ready-made reports on tracked time: pick a template and dates, then print the result or download a CSV.
rep.footNote: Generated by paratrack from tracked time. Billable columns use each project's hourly rate.
imp.title: Import from another tracker
imp.blurb: Bring your history over from Toggl, Harvest or Clockify. Entries become ordinary sessions.
imp.extraHint: Harvest: account id. Clockify: workspace id. Toggl: leave empty.
imp.hint: Only finished entries move over; running timers are skipped. You see a preview and confirm first.
push.title: Push notifications
push.blurb: Get a browser notification when a session stops, an invoice is paid, or a pay run is closed.
push.ev1: Session stopped (by hand or when a timer ends)
push.ev4: Goal thresholds (when a goal is met)
push.active: Push is on for this browser.
push.off: Push is off for this browser.
push.denied: Permission denied. Allow notifications in the browser settings.
rep.by-project.name: Hours by project
rep.by-activity.name: Hours by activity
rep.by-day.name: Hours by day
rep.billable.name: Billable summary
rep.utilization.name: Team utilization
rep.utilization.blurb: Planned schedule vs actual tracked per person.
mkt.github.blurb: Import open issues from a repository and start timers on them.
mkt.gitlab.blurb: Import open issues from a project, self-hosted or gitlab.com.
mkt.jira.blurb: Pull unresolved issues via JQL and track time against them.
mkt.clickup.blurb: Import open tasks from a list.
mkt.asana.blurb: Import incomplete tasks from a project.
mkt.trello.blurb: Import open cards from a board.
mkt.notion.blurb: Query a database and track time against its pages.
mkt.todoist.blurb: Import active tasks (optionally filtered to one project).
mkt.slack.blurb: Start a timer from a /paratrack slash command. Coming soon.
ts.emptyHint: Start the timer on the dashboard and the activity will appear here as a row.
pay.emptyHint: Set hourly pay in Settings → Members, track some time, then generate a run.
rep.emptyHint: Track some time in the selected dates, or widen the range and run again.
help.title: Help
help.blurb: Everything paratrack can do, in one place.
help.track1d: On the dashboard: type an activity, optionally pick a project and add a note, press Start. The timer ticks live under Running now.
help.track2d: "Only this" pauses every other timer and keeps this one running. "Stop" closes the session and moves it to Recent.
help.track3d: Free-form times: "yesterday 14:00", "2h ago", "2026-09-22 09:00". It is at the bottom of the dashboard, under "Add a past session".
help.review1d: Breakdown by project and activity with period, project and tag filters. Inline-edit any session row (start, end, duration, note, tags). Filters live in the URL, so you can share the link.
help.review2d: Bars by hour of day for the chosen period: when you usually work, and on what.
help.review3d: Timesheet: your week as a table, minutes per activity per day. Schedule plans people across projects and shows their load.
help.review4d: Goals track minutes per activity per day, week or month. Tags label sessions. A saved report remembers the Stats period and filters so you can reopen them in one click.
help.org1d: Colored projects group activities. Pick a project right on the timer; any imported task starts in one click.
help.org2d: Set a time budget on the project, in minutes. The project page shows how much is spent and what share of the budget that is.
help.org3d: Set an hourly rate and toggle billable. Non-billable projects never land on an invoice.
help.money1d: An invoice is built from tracked time on billable projects for a period. Download it as a PDF, add a payment link, or mark it paid.
help.money2d: Set hourly pay for members in Settings → Members, then generate a pay run for a period and mark it paid.
help.money3d: Five built-in templates (by project / activity / day, billable, utilization) with HTML and CSV output.
help.team1d: Every account gets a personal workspace. Create more and rename them; switch from the team menu at the top (on a phone: More → Workspaces). Members can be added and removed.
help.team2d: Create a link in Settings → Invites and send it. The person opens it, signs in or signs up, and joins the team.
help.eco1d: Connect GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Todoist or Notion and import tasks. The marketplace lists what is live and what is coming.
help.eco2d: Settings → API tokens issues pt_… keys. Use them as Authorization: Bearer for /api/v1/* or the browser extension.
help.eco3d: Webhooks POST signed events (X-Paratrack-Signature). The audit log keeps the last 100 security and ops events.
help.eco4d: Installable PWA. Offline changes queue and replay on reconnect. Browser push notifies about stopped sessions, paid invoices and closed pay runs.
help.where1: API tokens for the browser extension and the API.
help.where2: Connected providers and the integration marketplace.
help.where3: Send events to other services. The Audit log tab next to it shows who did what.
help.where5: Import from Toggl, Harvest or Clockify.
onb.title: Welcome: three steps to your first hour
onb.blurb: paratrack counts where your time goes. Do these three things and the rest of the product starts making sense.
onb.s1d: Type an activity in the field above and press Start. The timer appears right under the field.
onb.s2d: Stats breaks the day down by project and activity. You can edit any row in place.
onb.s3d: Projects group activities and hold the billable rate. You can attach one when you start a timer.
onb.footer: The full feature map lives in
inv.emptyHint: Generate a client invoice from tracked billable time.
int.emptyHint: Connect a provider and import tasks you can start timers on.
sch.emptyHint: Planning needs a project to spread the week across. Create one, then come back.
push.emptyHint: Press Enable notifications in this browser to subscribe this device.
audit.emptyHint: Events appear here as people use the workspace: sign-ins, timer starts, invoices, pay runs.
bill.badRate: Rate must be a number, e.g. 45.50
dash.backfillHint: Forgot to start a timer? Log it after the fact.
inv.noRateHint: Invoices only include time on billable projects with a rate. Without one the invoice comes out empty.
pwa.description: Time tracking with parallel timers, projects and team workspaces.
pwa.offline: Offline. Actions are saved and sent when you reconnect.
pwa.sendError: Could not reach the server, nothing was saved. Check your connection and try again.
pwa.iosInstall: Tap Share at the bottom of Safari, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa.queued: Offline. The action is saved and will be sent with its original time once you reconnect.
set.title: Settings
set.desc.settings-profile: Your name, email and password. Visible only to you and members of your teams.
set.desc.settings-notify: Push notifications on this device for key events: timer stopped, invoice paid, goal reached.
set.desc.settings-team: The current workspace: name, other teams, online invoice payment and deletion.
set.desc.settings-members: Who is in the workspace, their role, hourly pay and daily capacity for the schedule.
set.desc.settings-invites: Create an invite link and send it any way you like. It lives 7 days and can be revoked.
set.desc.settings-tokens: Keys for scripts and integrations: API calls on your behalf. A token is shown once, keep it like a password.
set.desc.settings-webhooks: URLs paratrack notifies on events (start, stop, invoice paid) so another service can react.
set.desc.settings-audit: Who did what in the workspace: sign-ins, timers, invoices, settings changes.
stats.blurb: Where your time went in the chosen period, by project and activity. Edit sessions right in the table, tag them, and save the period as a report.
graph.pageBlurb: Which hours of the day you usually work, and on what. Pick a period to see your rhythm.
bill.rateHint: Amount per hour of work, used for client invoices. E.g. 45.50.
projects.archivedHint: hidden from lists and the start form
wh.secretHint: If set, every request is signed so your server can verify it came from paratrack.
int.nameHint: How this connection is labeled in the list.
int.key.github: Personal access token from GitHub → Settings → Developer settings, with repo scope.
int.key.gitlab: Personal access token from GitLab → Preferences → Access tokens, read_api scope.
int.key.jira: Email and API token joined by a colon: you@company.com:token. Create the token at id.atlassian.com.
int.key.trello: Key and token joined by a colon: key:token, from trello.com/power-ups/admin.
int.key.asana: Personal access token from Asana → My settings → Apps → Developer apps.
int.key.clickup: API token from ClickUp → Settings → Apps, starts with pk_.
int.key.todoist: API token from Todoist → Settings → Integrations → Developer.
int.key.notion: Internal integration secret from notion.so/my-integrations, starts with ntn_. Share the database with it.
int.target.github: Repository as owner/repo. Blank: issues assigned to you.
int.target.jira: Project key (PROJ) or a JQL query.
int.target.trello: Board id: the part of the link after /b/.
int.target.asana: Project GID: the number in the project link.
int.target.clickup: List id: the number in the list link.
int.target.notion: Database id: 32 characters from the database link.
stripe.keyHint: Stripe → Developers → API keys. Invoices then get a "Pay online" button.
stripe.whHint: Lets a paid invoice flip to "paid" by itself.
imp.key.toggl: API token from Toggl → Profile settings, bottom of the page.
imp.key.clockify: API key from Clockify → Profile settings → API.
imp.extraHintHarvest: Shown next to the token on the developers page.
imp.extraHintClockify: The part of the Clockify URL after /workspaces/.
auth.registerBlurb: paratrack shows where your time goes: start a timer on a task and it sorts the hours by project, day and client. Sign-up takes a minute and your personal workspace is ready right away.
toast.stoppedFull: Stopped: {name}, {dur}. It is in Recent and in Stats.

flash.msg.no billable time in that perio: No billable time in that period. Check that the project is billable and has a rate.
flash.msg.no paid members with tracked t: Nobody with hourly pay tracked time in that period.
flash.msg.bad capacity: Capacity must be a number of minutes.
flash.msg.bad url: Enter a full URL starting with https://
flash.msg.estimate must be a number of m: The plan must be a number of minutes.
flash.inviteCreated: Invite link created, send it to the person:
err.backfillRequired: Fill in the activity, start and end.
